# Career Source Group

> Career Source Group (CSG) is a US-based global staffing and talent delivery firm placing direct-hire, contract, and contract-to-hire talent across three regions — the US, LATAM (nearshore), and Pakistan (offshore) — under one contract, one invoice, and one point of contact. Direct-hire fee is 10% of first-year salary, versus the 20-30% industry standard.

Key facts:
- Legal name: Career Source Group, LLC
- Headquarters: Alpharetta, Georgia, United States
- Contact: hello@careersourcegroup.com, +1-443-875-9677
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 5 PM (US Eastern); closed weekends
- Regions served: United States (direct hire, contract, contract-to-hire), LATAM/Mexico (contract, nearshore, 30-70% cost savings vs. US), Pakistan (contract, offshore, 50-70% cost savings vs. US)
- Delivery models: individual specialist placement, and the "pod" model — a complete purpose-built team sized against experience, communication skill, technical skill, and cost, delivered under one SOW

- [Staffing Roles](https://careersourcegroup.com/staffing/roles): Individual specialists placed into a defined seat, priced across all three regions
- [Pods](https://careersourcegroup.com/staffing/pods): The pod model explained — how purpose-built teams are sized and delivered
- [Specialized Roles](https://careersourcegroup.com/staffing/specialized-roles): The nine technical practices CSG recruits for — AI/ML, MLOps, data engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps/platform engineering, cloud, software development, product/project management, and cybersecurity & GRC
- [Global Delivery](https://careersourcegroup.com/global-delivery): Honest comparison of US vs. LATAM nearshore vs. Pakistan offshore staffing
- [FAQ](https://careersourcegroup.com/faq): Answers on pricing, engagement types, region selection, vetting, and delivery speed for both clients and candidates
- [Global Talent Cost & Delivery Comparison](https://careersourcegroup.com/offer-calibration): What a given compensation offer actually buys, broken down by role and region
- [Insights](https://careersourcegroup.com/insights): Staffing strategy and workforce insight articles
- [Get Started](https://careersourcegroup.com/get-started): Submit a staffing requirement
- [Join Our Bench](https://careersourcegroup.com/join-our-bench): Candidate application for contract and full-time AI, data, and cloud roles
- [Contact](https://careersourcegroup.com/contact): General contact form
